description: A Kotlin class 'CompassSensorManager' that manages device sensors to provide stabilized compass heading (azimuth). Implements sensor fusion from rotation vector and fallback to accelerometer + magnetometer, applies angle-aware smoothing, and detects magnetic interference. Handles sensor initialization, event processing, filtering, and UI update rate limiting.

classes.name: CompassSensorManager
classes.description: Manages device sensors to calculate a stabilized azimuth (compass heading). Uses rotation vector or fallback to accelerometer + magnetometer, applies smoothing, and detects magnetic interference.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Registers sensor listeners, preferring rotation vector if available.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners and resets internal state.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming sensor data, processes rotation vector or fallback.

methods.name: computeFallback
methods.description: Calculates azimuth from accelerometer and magnetometer data when rotation vector is unavailable.

methods.name: dispatchFiltered
methods.description: Sends the smoothed azimuth to the listener if update interval has passed.

methods.name: azimuthFromRotationVector
methods.description: Computes azimuth in degrees from rotation vector data.

methods.name: smoothAngle
methods.description: Applies angle-aware exponential smoothing to reduce jitter.

methods.name: updateInterferenceSignals
methods.description: Heuristically detects magnetic interference based on sensor accuracy and magnetic field magnitude.

methods.name: vectorMagnitude
methods.description: Calculates the magnitude of a 3D vector.

methods.name: normalize360
methods.description: Normalizes an angle in degrees to the [0, 360) range.

methods.name: shortestSignedAngleDelta
methods.description: Calculates the shortest signed difference between two angles.

methods.name: onAccuracyChanged
methods.description: No implementation; method required by SensorEventListener.
